lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. Centroids are arranged in an approximately orthogonal grid with vertical spacing of roughly three spot-diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming high-contrast anchor nodes at each intersection point across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular prominent horizontal feature is visible across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and a defined shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct morphological transition occurs anterior to the first gill slit, where large flank blobs are replaced by a high-density cluster of micro-spots across the cephalic region.
